_extraction_context.snippet_primary: "I made a sale on Tuesday and the customer was charged the discounted rate. I checked my settings and they were set to the retail rate so I contacted Etsy help and was told that they are in the process of eliminating that because sellers shouldn't charge more than what they pay for the shipping. This is Etsy move to be more 'transparent'. The problem is sometimes I need to ad more insurance or I underestimate the packed weight not to mention the the transaction fee. I wish Etsy would stop micromanaging and stop nibbling away my small profit."
_extraction_context.subject_exact: Etsy is eliminating the retail shipping rate option to enforce sellers charging only their actual discounted rates; seller criticizes loss of ability to cover insurance, weight estimation errors, and transaction fees
local_qualifiers: Etsy eliminating retail rate shipping option
